assessment.result: Existing inspect owns bounded source facts; dedicated early elf_layout branch is coherent. run shares the existing report read/recheck/JSON lifecycle. Standard debug/elf avoids a duplicate parser. No new functions/helpers/closures/dependencies. ELFMapping keeps optional file ranges and original PH indices explicit; starts/byStart and the two-region loop each have a distinct necessary role.

LOAD file/memory bounds, Filesz<=Memsz, 32-bit endpoint, alignment/congruence and overlaps refuse. Nonempty LOAD last-byte probe catches a shorter ReaderAt payload. Original header order/indices remain intact while sorted starts drive lookup. Only file_backed pieces carry file offsets; empty LOAD maps nothing. Query count and total pieces are bounded; exclusive end 2^32 is local to this report.

CLI forbids registry/glyphmap/apply/output for elf_layout, requires source hash/size, rehashes and rechecks source before emitting JSON. New AddressRanges is refused by plan, planBundle, references, authorRegistry and font-only inspect via its exact allowed-profile check. Existing inspection/patch paths are unchanged outside the new early branch and explicit foreign-field guards.

independent_CLI_probes.method: Independent ELF32 byte construction and byte-by-byte memory classification oracle, preserving original PH indices; explicit native boundary expected rows, not candidate-derived expectations.
cases: shuffled LOADs interspersed with non-LOAD; adjacent BSS-only region; VMA0 and Paddr distinct; nine half-open queries
five coherent LOAD defects: filesz/memsz, align power, align congruence, memory wrap, file bound
empty query label, stale source pin, unrelated placement, apply/output refusal
frozen executable file/BSS boundary, BSS/empty-LOAD boundary and sentinel unmapped
independent_CLI_probes.input_preservation: Every probe preserves input bytes/inode/mtime and recipe bytes; refused publication creates no output.

frozen_native_binding.result: Both program headers match independent struct unpacking; file-backed VMA ends0x539680/file0x439700, BSS ends0x580300; empty LOAD and sentinel map no bytes. Read only, never executed.

limits: Focused review only; no full suite/race/227 corpus or exhaustive malformed-ELF campaign.
Does not establish runtime loader behavior, unused/safe cave ownership, allocation/growth, GP reachability, ISO translation, fixed CRT0 checks or whole image_layout family completion.
No production/test/doc edits; no ISO/canonical registry/emulator/PINE/controller/process/settings access. Reviewer supplies findings, not acceptance authority.
